Compute Co-occurrence Count Matrix

Source: R/cohalu_functions.R
compute_count.Rd

Compute Co-occurrence Count Matrix

Usage

compute_count(
  adj,
  int_clust_row,
  int_clust_col,
  n_cls,
  cluster_data,
  transformation = FALSE
)

Arguments

adj

Adjacency matrix.

int_clust_row

Vector of cluster labels for rows.

int_clust_col

Vector of cluster labels for columns.

n_cls

Number of clusters.

cluster_data

Original cluster assignments.

transformation

If `TRUE`, `adj` holds link weights (e.g. 1 / (1 + d_u)) that are summed; `FALSE` (default) counts binary links.

Value

A co-occurrence count matrix.

Examples

set.seed(1)
adj <- Matrix::rsparsematrix(20, 20, density = 0.2)
cl <- factor(sample(c("a", "b"), 20, replace = TRUE))
lab <- paste0("Cluster", cl)
compute_count(adj, lab, lab, n_cls = 2, cluster_data = cl)
#>          Clustera Clusterb
#> Clustera        0        1
#> Clusterb        0        1
